definitions.gloss: proficiency; mastery; becoming skilled through practice
definitions.explanation: The state of having become highly skilled at something through sustained practice and experience. Emphasizes the process of maturing into competence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a craftsman who has mastered the technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to become proficient in English.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{剣術|けんじゅつ}→剣術：20194_kenjutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}なくなかった→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There were many warriors who achieved mastery of swordsmanship through years of training.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a suru verb. The pattern is ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become proficient at ~). The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the skill or subject.
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to master ~)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ + noun (a noun skilled at ~)
- {熟達|じゅくたつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (expert, master)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上達|じょうたつ}→上達：03346_joutatsu⟧ (improvement — emphasizes getting better, can apply at any level)
- {熟達|じゅくたつ} (mastery — emphasizes reaching a high level of skill through maturation)
- ⟦{精通|せいつう}→精通：15453_seitsuu⟧ (being well-versed — emphasizes knowledge rather than skill)
